system.description: Grew up in a smithy, workshop, mill, studio, construction yard, or another household centered on skilled production.

legacy.name: Inherited Tools
legacy.text: Choose one ordinary Toolkit during Character Creation. It does not consume Armory capacity and may be included in your Inventory without consuming Inventory capacity. You may replace it at the end of an Adventure or during suitable Downtime.

familiarity.name: Workshop Rhythm
familiarity.text: You recognize common materials, construction methods, maker's marks, rushed workmanship, and obvious substitutions. You understand workshop hierarchy and can approach laborers, apprentices, and craftspeople without behaving like an intrusive outsider.
